description: This file implements a subset of the POSIX pthread API for Windows, providing thread creation, joining, self identification, and condition variable wait functionality with Windows-specific system calls.

methods.name: unsigned __stdcall win32_start_routine(void * arg)
methods.description: Thread startup routine that sets the thread ID and executes the start routine.

methods.name: int pthread_create(pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Creates a new thread executing the specified start routine with the given argument.

methods.name: int win32_pthread_join(pthread_t * thread,void ** value_ptr)
methods.description: Waits for a thread to finish and optionally retrieves its return value.

methods.name: pthread_t pthread_self(void)
methods.description: Returns a pthread_t structure representing the current thread.

methods.name: int pthread_cond_wait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mutex)
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with an associated mutex.

ctags.name: pthread_create
ctags.signature: (pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
